title: X-Boundary: Establishing Exact Safety Boundary to Shield LLMs from Jailbreak Attacks without Compromising Usability
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of LLM safety boundaries and jailbreak defense. While it includes specific test cases involving a priest's confession (religion) and ethical scenarios, these are utilized as qualitative examples of technical robustness and over-refusal rather than as a systematic evaluation of religious or ethical frameworks.
